name: Colonycraft
description: Found colonies with a Town Hall, buy prefab farms, fisheries, mines, lumber camps, workshops, storehouses, harbors, train stations and medieval walls with Marks, and let your villagers gather for you. Wages every morning, optional auto-sell to the Market. Works with Warehouse, Cargo Train, Havana and Burlap Sack. Server-side: vanilla clients can join.
